name: jeffort
description: Per-turn effort routing with TypeSafe's Jev, applied per request at turn.step. Off until /jev on.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or JEV_API_KEY from the environment.

enabled_by_default.title: Route every session
enabled_by_default.description: On: routing starts on in every session. Off: each session starts off until you type /jev on.

max_effort.title: Highest effort to route to
max_effort.description: The router never picks a level above this one.

route_subagents.title: Route subagent models
route_subagents.description: Pick each subagent's model from the kind of work it is given (judgment or delegated).

judgment_model.title: Model for judgment subagents
judgment_model.description: Review, verification, design and root-cause debugging subagents run on this model alias.

delegated_model.title: Model for delegated subagents
delegated_model.description: Implementation, research, search and mechanical-edit subagents run on this model alias.

redact.title: Redact before sending
redact.description: Replace code blocks, secrets, URLs, e-mails, IPs and absolute paths with markers before a prompt goes to TypeSafe.

cache_safe_only.title: Only route cache-safe models
cache_safe_only.description: Change effort only on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1, where a per-request effort change keeps the prompt cache.

cache_guard.title: Pause on cache misses
cache_guard.description: Warn after an effort change that re-read the whole prompt cache, and pause routing after the second one.

timeout_ms.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long a turn waits for Jev before it starts at the session's effort.

show_decisions.title: Show routing lines
show_decisions.description: Show a dim line in the transcript when the router changes a turn's effort or a subagent's model.

base_url.title: TypeSafe API base URL
base_url.description: https only (or http to localhost). Change only to go through your own proxy.

jev_model.title: Jev model
jev_model.description: Pinned because the policy thresholds were tuned on it. Rerun the eval before changing.
